CLASS Say
    PUBLIC
    STATIC METHOD Iki() AS I32
        RETURN 2
    END METHOD
    STATIC METHOD Topla(a AS I32, b AS I32) AS I32
        RETURN a + b
    END METHOD
    STATIC METHOD Fark(a AS I32, b AS I32, c AS I32) AS I32
        RETURN a - b - c
    END METHOD
    METHOD Dort() AS I32
        RETURN Say.Iki() * 2
    END METHOD
END CLASS
CLASS Yardim
    PUBLIC
    STATIC METHOD Kare(n AS I32) AS I32
        RETURN n * n
    END METHOD
END CLASS

CLASS Vek
    PUBLIC
    DIM x AS I32

CLASS Say
    PUBLIC
    STATIC METHOD Fakt(k AS I32) AS I32
        IF k <= 1 THEN
            RETURN 1
        END IF
        RETURN k * Fakt(k - 1)
    END METHOD
END CLASS
CLASS Alt EXTENDS Say
    PUBLIC
    METHOD Kullan() AS I32
        RETURN Fakt(4)
    END METHOD
END CLASS
DIM a AS Alt = NEW Alt()
PRINT Say.Fakt(5)
PRINT a.Kullan()
